test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If A is an acute angle and p tan A = n sec A, then find the value of (p² - n²)/(pn).
solution:
**Given:**

p tan A = n sec A

**Formula used:**

⇒ p/n = sec A ÷ tan A

⇒ p/n = (1/cos A) ÷ (sin A/cos A)

⇒ p/n = 1/sin A

⇒ p = n / sin A

**Calculation:**

⇒ p² = n² / sin²A

⇒ p² − n² = n²(1/sin²A − 1)
